title: Théorie arithmétique. Théorie de Galois des motifs (1965) : notes manuscites (s.d.), tapuscrit (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
The page is printed upside down in the scan. It is not Grothendieck's own mathematics. It is page '1-36' of a typed draft numbered 'n° 413'. That numbering is typical of Bourbaki rédactions. The subject is point distributions (distributions ponctuelles) on C^r manifolds, the setting of Bourbaki's Variétés différentielles et analytiques and Groupes et algèbres de Lie Ch. III. It sits among Grothendieck's 1965 'Galois theory of motives' notes, presumably because he received or reused Bourbaki drafts (possibly as scrap paper). Neighbouring pages are a handwritten note on Hodge structures and places, and a faint typed page.

The mathematics, in modern terms:
- Setup. Let X be a C^r manifold and t_i a point distribution of order ≤ s_i on X_i, i.e. an element of the jet dual (the space of differential operators at a point). For φ: X = ∏X_i → Y, the φ-convolution is t_1 *^φ … *^φ t_n := φ_*(t_1⊗…⊗t_n). This pushforward makes sense when Σs_i ≤ r.
- Multilinearity. The map (t_i) ↦ t_1*…*t_n is a multilinear morphism of vector bundles. It therefore extends to a map ∏E^{(s_i)}(X_i) → E^{(s)}(X).
- Proposition 19 (associativity / functoriality). For φ = ∏φ_i with φ_i: ∏_j X_ij → Y_i, and ψ: ∏Y_i → Z, one has *^{ψ∘φ}(t_ij) = *^ψ( *^{φ_i}(t_ij)_j )_i. This follows from functoriality of pushforward, (ψ∘φ)_* = ψ_*φ_*, together with compatibility of φ_* with tensor products of point distributions (formulas (18), (20)).
- Corollary (naturality). If φ'∘f = g∘φ with f = ∏f_i, then *^{φ'}(f_{i*}t_i) = g_*(*^φ t_i) = *^{g∘φ}(t_i).

This is the standard machinery behind defining the convolution algebra of point distributions on a Lie group (the enveloping algebra realized as distributions supported at the identity).
errors: In formula (21) the range of i is typed as 1≤i≤m; it should be 1≤i≤n (typographical slip).
The corollary says 's inférieur à r'; it should be read as s ≤ r. The order condition is also needed for f_{i*} and g_* to be defined on the jets. This is a minor imprecision only.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a Bourbaki draft (rédaction n° 413) on point distributions, misfiled or reused in Grothendieck's motives folder. Its content is routine and was published in Bourbaki. The only point of interest is archival: Bourbaki material sits among these notes.
transcription_corrections: The page image is upside down; the text is a typed Bourbaki rédaction (header 'n° 413', page '1 - 36').
